author: claude
summary: Audited every modal/overlay component for adoption of the existing useFocusTrap hook (task 010 of the backlog-batch-mobile-mode-and-cleanup plan). Found 5 files / 7 modal instances with zero focus trapping and adopted the hook in each, following ConfirmModal.tsx's exact pattern (dialogRef + useFocusTrap(ref, isOpen) + role=dialog/aria-modal). Deliberately left SegmentDetailPopover (SegmentRenderMonitor.tsx) untrapped -- it's an intentionally non-modal anchored popover per its own code comment, forcing a trap would change designed behavior.

files.change: Added dialogRef + useFocusTrap + role=dialog/aria-modal (was previously untrapped).
Adopted useFocusTrap independently in all 4 modal components: NewVoiceModal, RenameVoiceModal, AddVariantModal, MoveVariantModal.

Adopted useFocusTrap for the shared Create-Project modal (two mutually-exclusive render sites -- empty vs populated library state -- driven by one showModal boolean, wired to one shared ref/trap call).
